title: Consent to teleconsultation
purpose: Before your video consultation we need your agreement to the items below. You can decline and book an in-person visit instead.

clauses.text: I agree to receive medical advice through a video consultation, and understand a physical examination is not possible.
I agree that the clinician may view my medical records held by this service.
I agree that this consultation may be recorded for quality review.
I agree that my de-identified data may be used for research.
